entities.name: Abd Allah Siraj
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdullah ibn Abdur-Rahman Siraj was a Jordanian politician and Islamic scholar who held various posts in the Kingdom of Hejaz and later the Emirate of Transjordan, including the office of Prime Minister of both countries.
